$note: 第 3 層試點（2026-10-11）：官祿宮天機。條件逐條跟《深造講義》下篇宮垣論・事業宮 p.522–524。⚠ 引擎冇天才、龍池鳳閣、天刑、大耗：「天才同度」「技藝」「刑耗」嘅分支判斷唔到，只用昌曲、煞忌。巳亥天機嗰幾段未讀，冇寫。

rules.text: 你的工作較常變動，形式不容易長期固定。
rules.en: Your work changes more often than most, and its form rarely stays fixed for long.

source.quote: 主一生事业多变，而且不稳定

rules.edit: 不加「厭倦重複」之類心理原因；原書在此沒有說。

rules.text: 同宮有火星或鈴星，你工作變動的幅度會更大。
rules.en: With Huo Xing or Ling Xing in the palace, the swings are bigger.

source.quote: 倘火铃同度，则更增加其波动

rules.text: 天機化祿，你的工作仍然多變，化祿並不改變這一點。
rules.en: Tian Ji is transformed by Lu, yet your work stays changeable; Lu does not alter that.

source.quote: 天机化禄，不能改变其不稳定的性质

rules.text: 加上〔吉星〕會合，變動較可能把你帶向更有前途的工作，或者同時兼兩三份事。
rules.en: With 〔favourable stars〕 joining in, the changes are more likely to lead you to work with better prospects, or to holding two or three roles at once.

source.quote: 则可能转变到从事有前途的工作

rules.text: 你的天機化權，工作反而會轉趨穩定；不過通常要先經歷一次轉變，才進入較穩定的事業。
rules.en: Your Tian Ji is transformed by Quan, so your work actually tends to settle; usually, though, there's one change first before you move into steadier work.

source.quote: 天机化权，性质变为稳定。但亦必先发生一次改变

rules.edit: 化權改變「多變」的基本性質，所以取代本條。

rules.text: 同宮又有左輔或右弼，可能身兼數職，而且多是較長期的工作。
rules.en: With Zuo Fu or You Bi in the palace too, you may hold several roles at once, mostly longer-term ones.

source.quote: 唯所兼职务均为较长期工作

rules.text: 天機化科，適合計劃、管理、設計一類的工作，也容易在行內建立名聲。
rules.en: Tian Ji transformed by Ke suits planning, management and design, and you can build a name in your field.

source.quote: 天机化科，则宜计划、管理、设计等工作

rules.text: 天機化忌，工作剛安定又要改變，而改變源自計劃出錯；遇到看似有利的機會，保守一點反而穩。
rules.en: Tian Ji transformed by Ji means work changes just as it settles, and the changes come from plans that went wrong; when an opportunity looks good, staying cautious is the safer course.

source.quote: 甫安定便告更张。所更张皆源于计划错误

rules.text: 天機又見空劫或煞星，你在工作上更容易做多錯多。
rules.en: Tian Ji also meets Kong, Jie or harsh stars, so at work, the more you do, the more easily things go wrong.

source.quote: 更属动辄得咎

rules.text: 同宮有文昌或文曲，你適合計劃、設計一類的工作。
rules.en: With Wen Chang or Wen Qu in the palace, planning and design work suits you.

source.quote: 天机与昌曲、天才同度，宜计划

rules.text: 你的天機獨坐子午，對宮是巨門：就算條件好，工作也要花不少心思經營；比起從零開創，你較適合在已有的架構裡發揮。
rules.en: Your Tian Ji sits alone in Zi or Wu, facing Ju Men: even when conditions are good, work takes a lot of careful managing, and you're better suited to working within an existing structure than starting from scratch.

source.quote: 即使会吉星祥曜，其事业亦必费心机

rules.edit: 原書另有「惰性」之說，屬人格評判，不用；「創業力薄弱」轉寫為較適合既有架構。

rules.text: 官祿宮的三方四正見〔煞忌〕，工作容易受外在環境牽動，常要奔波勞累。
rules.en: With 〔malefics or Ji〕 in the four directions of your career palace, work is easily pushed around by outside circumstances, with a lot of running about.

source.quote: 则往往受客观环境影响，为事业奔波劳累

rules.edit: 只講環境牽動的方向，不斷事件或程度；會照不等於同宮。

rules.text: 在午宮，較適合在現成的局面裡發展，例如進入大機構，或者接手家裡原有的事業。
rules.en: In Wu, you're better suited to growing within something already established, such as joining a large organisation or taking over a family business.

source.quote: 宜承继父业发展，亦宜入大机构

rules.text: 在子宮，這份經營的辛苦往往更重，也容易招惹是非。
rules.en: In Zi, the effort of managing it all tends to be heavier, and it more easily draws gossip and friction.

source.quote: 其辛苦劳累往往倍之。且易招是非

rules.text: 你的天機在丑未，較適合在機構裡任職；對宮天梁帶計劃、監察、管理的意味，財經、會計、計劃一類的部門都合適。
rules.en: Your Tian Ji is in Chou or Wei, which suits working within an organisation; facing Tian Liang adds a flavour of planning, oversight and management, so finance, accounting or planning departments fit well.

source.quote: 故宜在公司机构任职

also.quote: 有计划、监察、管理的意味

rules.text: 三方四正見〔煞忌〕，你的工作或任職的機構常會轉換。
rules.en: With 〔malefics or Ji〕 in the four directions, you change jobs or employers often.

source.quote: 则常转换事业，或转换服务机构

rules.text: 天機太陰同守，你的事業多半由現成的基礎發展。
rules.en: With Tian Ji and Tai Yin together, your career mostly grows from a foundation that's already there.

source.quote: 亦主由现成事业发展

rules.text: 三方四正沒有祿權科會合，較適合在政府或大機構任職，不宜經商。
rules.en: With no Lu, Quan or Ke in the four directions, a post in government or a large organisation suits you better than running a business.

source.quote: 一般宜任职而不宜经商

rules.text: 天機太陰見〔煞忌〕或空劫，你更不宜自己出來經商。
rules.en: Tian Ji–Tai Yin meets 〔harsh stars, Obstruction〕, Kong or Jie, so running your own business suits you even less.

source.quote: 有煞忌、空劫，则绝不宜经商

rules.edit: 原句續講「必有一次重大破敗」及應期，屬事件預言，不用。

rules.text: 天機巨門要有化祿或祿存同宮，事業才有發展的空間；你的盤正有這個條件。
rules.en: Tian Ji with Ju Men needs Lu, as a transformation or as Lu Cun in the palace, for a career to have room to grow, and your chart has it.

source.quote: 必须有化禄或禄存同度，始有事业发展

rules.text: 天機巨門要有化祿或祿存同宮，事業才較有發展空間；你的盤未見這個配合，發展上要多花力氣。
rules.en: Tian Ji with Ju Men needs Lu, as a transformation or as Lu Cun in the palace, for a career to have room to grow; your chart doesn't show it, so progress takes more effort.

source.quote: 必须有化禄或禄存同度，始有事业发展

rules.edit: 原書只講有祿的條件；「要多花力氣」是編輯推論，不寫成沒有發展。

rules.text: 同宮有火星或鈴星，會令你工作上的變動和是非都加重。
rules.en: Huo Xing or Ling Xing in the palace makes both the changes and the friction heavier.

source.quote: 增加天机之浮荡，巨门之是非

rules.text: 天機天梁同守，你最容易身兼幾份工作。
rules.en: With Tian Ji and Tian Liang together, you're most likely to hold several jobs at once.

source.quote: 最易兼行兼职

rules.text: 加上〔吉化〕或吉星，顧問一類的工作對你最合適。
rules.en: With 〔favourable transformations〕 or stars in view, advisory work suits you best.

source.quote: 以从事顾问工作为适宜

rules.text: 適合帶流動性質的工作，例如零售、運輸、旅遊、傳播；重點是工作本身有變化，不必拘泥行業名稱。
rules.en: Work with built-in movement suits you, such as retail, transport, travel or media; what matters is that the work itself varies, not the name of the industry.

source.quote: 从事行业以带不稳定性质

rules.edit: 行業是原書用來說明性質的例子，不是職業清單。
